card.name: Inside hydrate salt-form names
card.fires_on: The piece just before "hydrate" in chemical names, mainly "mon" or "oh" in monohydrate, also "dih" and "hex". Seen in ingredient and composition lines such as cephalexin monohydrate.

modes.label: Monohydrate split
modes.description: The "mon" or "oh" piece inside monohydrate after a drug or excipient name.

modes.label: Other hydrate forms
modes.description: The start of dihydrate or hexahydrate, or a word before a salt form.

card.writes: It pushes toward finishing the word "hydrate" and, weakly, toward words about disposal.
card.plain: It fires while the model is partway through writing "monohydrate" or "dihydrate" in a drug's ingredient name.
